problem: What linear transformation $T$ is represented by the matrix $T=[\begin{aligned}12 & 0 \\ 0 & 12\end{aligned}]?$
worked_solution:
Recall that a dilation of scale factor $k$ is represented by the matrix

$$
[\begin{aligned}k & 0 \\ 0 & k\end{aligned}].
$$

Here, we have $k=12.$ Therefore, the matrix represents a dilation with a scale factor of $12.$
